prompt:

Asset type: one isolated transparent 3D editorial website illustration, landscape 3:2 composition, not a website or page composition.
Primary request: a miniature cutaway request-processing machine cabinet, the hidden machinery behind a website login. Show only the cabinet, no interface. The app will overlay all text, login facade, papers and request envelopes later in HTML.
Subject and composition: a small landscape rectangular cabinet seen frontally with a very slight view of its top and right side, almost orthographic; entire cabinet visible with at least 8 percent transparent margin on every edge. Thick warm cream enamel outer frame, a clearly visible continuous top rim and bottom rim, precise softly rounded manufactured corners. Recessed dark warm ink-brown interior. Most of the central interior MUST be a generous completely EMPTY dark rectangular bay, flat unobstructed dark back panel, reserved for overlaying real HTML paper-data pieces. The empty bay occupies approximately the middle 50 percent of canvas width and middle 48 percent of canvas height. Confine a few simple orange copper rollers and bent pipe mechanisms to narrow left and right side channels; do not run any pipe, bar, divider, cable or mechanism through the central empty bay.
Materials and light: tactile miniature product still-life, sophisticated premium editorial 3D illustration, warm cream enamel (#fff6e7), warm ink-brown recess (#271c16), orange and copper mechanisms (#f48743), precise warm studio lighting with gentle contact shading inside the cabinet, detailed solid material surfaces and restrained brushed copper, clean silhouette.
Background: actual fully transparent alpha outside the object; no ground plane, floor, pedestal, cast shadow on a surface, painted background, gradient backdrop or checkerboard. Keep the dark opaque inner back panel; transparency only outside the cabinet.
Constraints: one object, no browser screen, no login UI, no screen, no written labels, no lettering, no numbers, no text, no logos, no padlock, no people, no robots, no creatures, no warning triangle, no binary or code, no busy circuit detail, no papers or envelopes, no extra objects. This is a reusable isolated asset, not a page mockup.
